text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is cited as the fastest production motorcycle.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is not road-legal in India.","cited_pids":["0d96b47079bb#1"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2 is named as one of India's strongest candidates for fastest production motorcycle.","cited_pids":["e3effe5ed347#2"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is reported at nearly 400 km/h.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#2"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is a track-only machine that cannot be ridden on Indian roads.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is sold as a special-order, closed-course machine.","cited_pids":["0d96b47079bb#1"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"The Ducati Panigale V4 R can exceed 330 km/h with a race exhaust.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#5"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"The BMW M 1000 RR is homologated to about 314 km/h.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#6"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"The sources favour the Ducati Panigale V4 R and BMW M 1000 RR as the fastest road-legal bikes.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#5","5bab82194822#6"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"The answer to which bike is fastest depends on whether track-only machines are counted.","cited_pids":[]}]}
